system.description: The character has learned to swim (without this knowledge, they cannot swim) and can add +2 to their Skill Value per level in the ability. They can normally move +1 meter per level per action round in the water, and hold person evading has a -4 modifier on their chance to succeed. The character cannot do anything else besides try to evade during that action. During a combat round, the character can evade one attack at specialty levels 1-2, two attacks at levels 3-4, and three attacks at level 5.
system.summary: Allows swimming, moving through water and holding breath for extended periods.
